verses.text: Ha wal Jehová tz'alani: Ex israel, tato t'a wal yel tze nib'ej tzex meltzajxi t'ayin, aktejekkan juntzanh he diosal yajb'entak chi'.
Hak'ek he ti' t'a wichanh, tzeyak'an elk'och tas tzeyala'. Ichato chi' b'i'an, ol in yik'ancha'anh masanil nación, ol wak'an in wach'k'olal t'a heb', xchi.

Syalanxi Jehová t'ayex, ex aj Judá yet' ex aj Jerusalén: Ix pitb'iel he pensar icha lum lum malaj mach smunlaj t'a sat, anhej te' k'ix sk'ib' t'ay. Komonok k'un tzeyutej jab'ok he pensar yik tz'och in lolonel t'ay.

Ex aj Judá yet' ex aj Jerusalén, k'anab'ajejek in trato ix in b'o heyet'ok. Ch'oxekel in trato t'a he b'eyb'al, haton in trato chab'il eyu'uj. Ojtakejek eli to a in ton Jehová he Diosal in. Tato ma'ay, a yuj he chuk b'eyb'al chi' skot yowal in k'ol t'a eyib'anh icha te' k'ak' manhxa mach syal smak'an tupok.

Alek juntzanh tik t'a heb' aj Judá yet' t'a heb' aj Jerusalén: Hak'ek ok' k'e'en trompeta t'a masanil chonhab', xe chi. Te cha'anh tzex awaji tzeyalan icha tik: Ko molb'ejek ko b'a t'a yol juntzanh chonhab' wach' yaj smuroal, xe chi.
Ik'ekcha'anh he bandera sch'oxani to sb'at he k'ub'ejel he b'a t'a Sion. Sayek ek' b'aj tze kol he b'a, manh ex och wa'an. Yujto ha t'a norte ol wik'kot jun niwan ya'elal ol satanel smasanil.

Icha yelta nok' choj b'aj ay, icha chi' ol aj skot heb' ol ul satanel juntzanh chonhab' tik. Toxo ix elta heb' t'a yol schonhab' yik tzul satanel he chonhab' tik heb', ol smak'anem lanhnaj heb', manhxa mach ol kan t'ay.
Yuj chi' ak'ekoch pichul ya swa'i, ok'anhek, elokab' eyaw yuj ya'elal, yujto a wal yowal in k'ol a in Jehová in tik manto el-laj t'a eyib'anh, xchi Jehová.

Ha wal Jehová tz'alanxi icha tik: Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', a winh rey yet' heb' yajal, ol el yip heb' yuj xiwelal. Ha heb' sacerdote yet' heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok, toxonhej ol satkan sk'ol heb', xchi.
Ix walan Jeremías in tik: Ay Mamin ¿tas yuj ix a k'exanh ti'ej heb' aj Jerusalén tik? Ix ak' a ti' ak'an junk'olal t'a heb', haxo tiknaik, a k'e'en kuchilub' ijanoch t'a sjaj heb' u'uj, xin chi.

Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ol wal t'a heb' aj Jerusalén: Ay jun takinh ik' skot t'a lum tzalkixtak ay t'a takinh lu'um. Sjawi xumnaj t'a stojolal in chonhab', manh ichok ik' tz'ik'anel smatz'il ixim trigo.
Ha jun ik' swak'kot chi', te ow t'a yichanh junxo ik' chi'. Ha jun ik' sb'inaj tik, haton ya'elal ol wak'kot t'a yib'anh in chonhab', xchi Jehová.

Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ilek wal skot heb' soldado ajk'o'ol, icha wal skot junok asun skot heb'. Ha wal scarruaje heb' lajan sb'ey icha chakxuxum ik'. Haxo nok' schej heb' ek'b'al sb'ey nok' t'a yichanh nok' ch'akb'a. Yuj chi' ol eyal icha tik: Ob'iltak onh wal, ol onh satelok, xe chama.
Ex aj Jerusalén, ik'ekel masanil chukal ay t'a he pensar yik wach' ol ex kolchajok. ¿B'ak'inhto wal ol eyaktej he na'an chukal?
Hato t'a Dan yet' t'a lum tzalkixtak yik Efraín, hata' skot yab'ixal owal.
Alek t'a juntzanh ch'ok chonhab'il yet' t'a Jerusalén to ha t'a jun chonhab' te najat ay, hata' skot heb' ajk'o'ol. Tz'el yaw heb' skot yak' owal yet' juntzanh chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá.
Ol oymaj heb' t'a chonhab' Jerusalén, icha heb' stanhwan junok munlajel. Ha in wal Jehová in swala' to icha chi' ol ujok, yujto ix ste pitej sb'a heb' t'ayin.
Yuj he b'eyb'al yet' tas tze k'ulej sjawi juntzanh tik t'a eyib'anh. Ha yuj he chukal, te chuk tz'aj eyelk'ochi, syab' wal sya'il he pixan yuj, xchi Jehová.
Ay..., ste kus in k'o'ol, tz'och wal pitz'an t'a in pixan. Stinhtinhan in pixan yuj tas sjawi chi'. Maxtzak in em numan. Toxo ix wab' yok' k'e'en trompeta yet' yel yaw heb' soldado yik tz'och owal.
Tzoltzon sja ab'ix yik juntzanh ya'elal sjawi. Masanil chonhab' tik toxo ix laj juwib'ati. Elanhchamel ix lajwiem ko campamento, ix ixtaxb'at b'aj kajan onh.
¿Jantakto wal tiempo ol wil sbandera heb' soldado yet' wab'an spukhaj k'e'en trompeta? xin chi.

Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ha heb' in chonhab', te malaj spensar heb', max in yojtakejel heb'. Lajan heb' icha heb' unin malaj jab'ok spensar, manh jab'ok snachajel yuj heb'. Te jelan heb' t'a chukal. Manh yojtakok heb' sk'ulan wach'il, xchi.
Ha in Jeremías in tik, ix ch'oxji wil sat lu'um tik, tz'inanxonhej ix ajkani. Ix wilpaxk'e satcha'anh, manhxalaj sakil k'inal t'ay.
Ix laj wil lum niwak witz, ix ib'xik'e lu'um yet' pax lum tzalkixtak, ix laj tzikub'tanhaj lu'um.
Ix wilani manhxalaj anima, haxo masanil nok' sjenhwi toxo ix b'at nok' elelal.
Ix wilanpaxi, a lum lum b'aj ay awb'en, toxo ix kan tzinan lu'um. Masanil chonhab' toxo ix juwiemi. Yuj yowal sk'ol Jehová icha chi' ix aj masanil juntzanh chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Masanil lum lum ol juwokb'atok, palta manh ol in satel lum t'a junelnhej.

Kuseltak ol ajkan lum lum tik, haxo satcha'anh ol k'ik'b'okkanok. Icha chi' ol ajok yujto icha chi' ix aj in na'ani, ix walan paxi. Manh ol in k'exlaj tas ix in na' chi', manh ol ek'b'atlaj tas ix wal chi', xchi Jehová.

Ayik syab'an heb' anima yel yaw heb' soldado ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej yet' heb' yet'nak sjul-lab', sb'at heb' elelal, b'at sk'ub'ejel sb'a heb' t'a kaltak te', sk'ekan lotzlon heb' t'a sattak k'e'en tenam. Yuj chi' ix laj kan tzinan schonhab' heb'. Manhxalaj mach skajnajkan t'ay.

Ha Jerusalén wan slajwiemi, lajan icha junok ix ix nab'axonhej syak'och sk'apak púrpura, syak'anoch k'e'en oro ix wach' yilji, k'ik' syutej stitak sat ix yak'an uk'ok. Manhxa yelk'och b'aj sb'o sb'a ix chi', yujto a heb' winh winak nib'ab'il yuj ix, yajb'ilxoel ix yuj heb' winh. Toxonhej sna heb' winh tas ol aj smilan ix heb' winh. Icha chi' wan sk'ulan Jerusalén yet' juntzanhxo ch'ok nacional.

Ha heb' aj Sion tz'el yaw chi'. Swab' wal yel yaw heb' icha yel yaw junok ix ix b'ab'elto tz'alji yune'. Sk'akwi heb', syak'anel li'an sk'ab' heb', syalan heb': Ay, ob'iltak onh. Ol onh miljokcham yuj heb' milum anima, xchi heb'.
